The company

2DY 2020

A family metalworking company, extended into design, site supervision and renovation. Every structure we deliver is built for real use.

Minimal

Sharp design, with full attention on the quality of execution and the clarity of the detail.

Professional

Clear documentation and controlled work at every stage, from the first measurement to installation.

Coordination

Defined deadlines and transparent communication for the whole duration of the project.

Services

Four disciplines, one standard

We work across four closely connected disciplines. It means a project can move from concept to fabrication and on to maintenance without changing partner.

01 Metalwork Design, fabrication and installation of metal structures, with a focus on safety and a clean finish. 02 Architecture & concept Concept, drawings and minimal visualisations, from the idea to the documentation. 03 Maintenance Periodic checks, repairs and servicing, quick, clean and accountable. 04 Project management Planning, coordination and control of schedule and budget for small and mid-sized projects.

What we work with

The choice of material and protective treatment determines how long a structure lasts. These are the finishes we work with most often.

Built to carry load

Materials & finishes

What we work with

Hot-rolled sections

Mild steel

Hot-rolled sections and beams, worked and welded to the loads of the project.

Galvanising

Hot-dip zinc

Maximum protection against corrosion for structures exposed to the weather.

Baked finish

Powder coat

A matt or satin finish, resistant to scratching and to sunlight.

Inox

Stainless steel

For elements that call for high resistance and a clean appearance over the long term.

Process

How we work

The same sequence on every project, whatever its size.

  1. 01

    Site survey

    A visit to the location, accurate measurements and a photographic record of the existing condition.

  2. 02

    Concept & quote

    The technical solution, the materials, the timeline and the cost: all in writing, before work begins.

  3. 03

    Fabrication

    Cutting, welding and protective treatment in the workshop, with a quality check at every step.

  4. 04

    Installation & handover

    Safe installation on site, correct levelling and a check of the finished work before handover.
